verdict.rationale: Termius supports saved hosts/groups with individual keychains, jump-host configs, and automatic per-host session logging, which together give each session its own context and history (termius-docs-1,2,3,7). However, there's no evidence of per-session appearance customization, and a community report notes the app lacks custom font support, undercutting the 'own appearance' aspect (termius-comm-8).
